name: codeatlas-website
description: Official production website for CodeAtlas Spring Boot Architecture Explorer VS Code extension.

scripts.build:deploy: mkdir -p dist/assets/css dist/assets/js dist/assets/images && cp index.html 404.html robots.txt sitemap.xml dist/ && cp assets/css/styles.css dist/assets/css/ && cp assets/js/app.js assets/js/graph-engine.js assets/js/shader.js dist/assets/js/ && cp assets/images/logo.jpg assets/images/*.png dist/assets/images/
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:deploy

author: CodeAtlas Engineering
